positive_prototypes: This paid interlude presents a sponsor's product and invites the viewer to use a promotional offer through a purchase or trial link.
A company supports this episode. The presenter describes the benefits of its service and asks viewers to register using a discount.
The creator advertises their own merchandise, books or courses and asks the audience to purchase them from their store.
The presenter asks for financial support through a paid membership and describes exclusive benefits available to paying supporters.
The creator promotes an original series on a subscription platform and invites viewers to subscribe for exclusive content.
This affiliate pitch encourages an order through a referral link and explains the offer available to the audience.
negative_prototypes: This product review compares performance, price, strengths and weaknesses to answer the main question of the video.
The speaker teaches a scientific or technical concept, describing an example, experiment or demonstration.
A brand or product is mentioned as relevant background, without asking the audience to buy or support anything.
The presenter explains how products were selected for testing, including suggestions from a community of viewers.
The speaker asks viewers to like the video, subscribe to the channel and enable notifications for future videos.
The video discusses advertising, sponsorship or the creator economy as its main subject rather than delivering a sales pitch.
